hebrew: אַ֥שְֽׁרֵי־הָאִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֤ר ׀ לֹ֥א הָלַךְ֮ בַּעֲצַ֪ת רְשָׁ֫עִ֥ים וּבְדֶ֣רֶךְ חַ֭טָּאִים לֹ֥א עָמָ֑ד וּבְמוֹשַׁ֥ב לֵ֝צִ֗ים לֹ֣א יָשָֽׁב׃
ko: 복되다, 그 사람은. 악인들의 조언을 따라 걷지 않고, 죄인들의 길에 서지 않으며, 비웃는 자들의 자리에 앉지 않는 사람.
en: Happy is the person who does not walk by the counsel of the wicked, stand in the way of sinners, or sit in the seat of scoffers.
es: Dichosa la persona que no camina según el consejo de los malvados, ni se detiene en el camino de los pecadores, ni se sienta en el asiento de los burladores.
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Psalm 1:1–6 (ko), research pilot v0.2.0. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/psalm-1/#v1

hebrew: כִּ֤י אִ֥ם בְּתוֹרַ֥ת יְהוָ֗ה חֶ֫פְצ֥וֹ וּֽבְתוֹרָת֥וֹ יֶהְגֶּ֗ה יוֹמָ֥ם וָלָֽיְלָה׃
ko: 오히려 그의 기쁨은 YHWH의 가르침에 있고, 그분의 가르침을 밤낮으로 읊조린다.
en: Rather, his delight is in YHWH’s instruction, and he recites it day and night.
es: Más bien, su deleite está en la instrucción de YHWH, y la recita día y noche.
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Psalm 1:1–6 (ko), research pilot v0.2.0. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/psalm-1/#v2

hebrew: וְֽהָיָ֗ה כְּעֵץ֮ שָׁת֪וּל עַֽל־פַּלְגֵ֫י מָ֥יִם אֲשֶׁ֤ר פִּרְי֨וֹ ׀ יִתֵּ֬ן בְּעִתּ֗וֹ וְעָלֵ֥הוּ לֹֽא־יִבּ֑וֹל וְכֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁר־יַעֲשֶׂ֣ה יַצְלִֽיחַ׃
ko: 그는 물길들 곁에 심긴 나무와 같아서, 제때 열매를 내고 잎이 시들지 않는다. 그가 하는 모든 일이 잘 이루어진다.
en: He is like a tree planted beside channels of water, yielding its fruit in its season, its leaf not withering. Everything he does prospers.
es: Es como un árbol plantado junto a canales de agua, que da su fruto a su tiempo y cuya hoja no se marchita. Todo lo que hace prospera.
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Psalm 1:1–6 (ko), research pilot v0.2.0. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/psalm-1/#v3

hebrew: לֹא־כֵ֥ן הָרְשָׁעִ֑ים כִּ֥י אִם־כַּ֝מֹּ֗ץ אֲֽשֶׁר־תִּדְּפֶ֥נּוּ רֽוּחַ׃
ko: 악인들은 그렇지 않다. 오히려 바람이 몰아내는 겨와 같다.
en: Not so the wicked! Rather, they are like chaff that the wind drives away.
es: ¡No así los malvados! Son como el tamo que el viento se lleva.
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Psalm 1:1–6 (ko), research pilot v0.2.0. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/psalm-1/#v4

hebrew: עַל־כֵּ֤ן ׀ לֹא־יָקֻ֣מוּ רְ֭שָׁעִים בַּמִּשְׁפָּ֑ט וְ֝חַטָּאִ֗ים בַּעֲדַ֥ת צַדִּיקִֽים׃
ko: 그러므로 악인들은 심판에서 서지 못하며, 죄인들은 의인들의 회중 가운데 서지 못한다.
en: Therefore the wicked will not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the assembly of the righteous.
es: Por eso los malvados no se mantendrán en pie en el juicio, ni los pecadores en la asamblea de los justos.
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Psalm 1:1–6 (ko), research pilot v0.2.0. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/psalm-1/#v5

hebrew: כִּֽי־יוֹדֵ֣עַ יְ֭הוָה דֶּ֣רֶךְ צַדִּיקִ֑ים וְדֶ֖רֶךְ רְשָׁעִ֣ים תֹּאבֵֽד׃
ko: YHWH께서 의인들의 길을 아시기 때문이다. 그러나 악인들의 길은 멸망한다.
en: For YHWH knows the way of the righteous, but the way of the wicked perishes.
es: Porque YHWH conoce el camino de los justos, pero el camino de los malvados perece.
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Psalm 1:1–6 (ko), research pilot v0.2.0. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/psalm-1/#v6

ko: YHWH께서 네게 복을 주시고 너를 지키시기를.
en: May YHWH bless you and guard you.
es: Que YHWH te bendiga y te guarde.
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Numbers 6:24–26 (ko), research pilot v0.2.0. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/numbers-6-24-26/#v24

ko: YHWH께서 그분의 얼굴을 네게 비추시고 네게 은혜를 베푸시기를.
en: May YHWH make his face shine toward you and be gracious to you.
es: Que YHWH haga brillar su rostro hacia ti y te conceda su favor.
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Numbers 6:24–26 (ko), research pilot v0.2.0. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/numbers-6-24-26/#v25

hebrew: יִשָּׂ֨א יְהוָ֤ה ׀ פָּנָיו֙ אֵלֶ֔יךָ וְיָשֵׂ֥ם לְךָ֖ שָׁלֽוֹם׃
ko: YHWH께서 그분의 얼굴을 네게로 드시고 네게 평안을 주시기를.
en: May YHWH lift his face toward you and give you peace.
es: Que YHWH alce su rostro hacia ti y te dé paz.
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Numbers 6:24–26 (ko), research pilot v0.2.0. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/numbers-6-24-26/#v26

hebrew: בְּהַנְחֵ֤ל עֶלְיוֹן֙ גּוֹיִ֔ם בְּהַפְרִיד֖וֹ בְּנֵ֣י אָדָ֑ם יַצֵּב֙ גְּבֻלֹ֣ת עַמִּ֔ים לְמִסְפַּ֖ר בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
ko: 지극히 높으신 이께서 민족들에게 기업을 나누어 주실 때, 인류를 갈라놓으실 때, 백성들의 경계를 하나님의 아들들의 수에 따라 정하셨다.
en: When the Most High apportioned inheritances to the nations, when he divided humankind, he fixed the boundaries of the peoples according to the number of the sons of God.
es: Cuando el Altísimo repartió herencias a las naciones, cuando separó a la humanidad, fijó los límites de los pueblos conforme al número de los hijos de Dios.
citation_ko: Hansam Yang. Original Bible: Deuteronomy 32:8 (ko), research pilot v0.2.0. https://yangs777.github.io/hansam-bible/ko/deuteronomy-32-8/#v8
